name: shopping-agent
description: Verify same-product offers across a bounded Shopify registry, then use Chrome only after complete zero-result coverage.

interface.shortDescription: Verify same-product offers across Shopify stores.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap-Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.3.0 searches a 45-store technically audited Shopify Storefront registry once, applies availability, latency, relevance, variant, condition, and price gates, groups cross-merchant offers only with exact GTIN or brand-plus-MPN identity and exact variants, labels non-comparable discovery results, and uses authorized Chrome only after complete API coverage returns zero products.
defaultPrompt: Shopify first. Call search_shopify_products exactly once: limit=3; selectionMode=MERCHANT_DIVERSE unless cheapest is explicit.
